name: openpixo/flat-vector
title: Flat vector
description: Geometric shapes and carefully limited colors for scalable, readable game assets.

description_i18n.en: Geometric shapes and carefully limited colors for scalable, readable game assets.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 以几何形体和精简配色，制作适合缩放、易于辨认的游戏素材。

examples.title: Resource tokens
examples.prompt: Generate six matching resource tokens using the flat-vector art style: wood, stone, food, water, energy and coin. Use geometric silhouettes and make every token clear at 32 pixels.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 flat-vector 美术风格生成六枚配套资源标记：木材、石头、食物、水、能量和金币。采用几何轮廓，确保每枚在 32 像素时仍清晰。

examples.title: Island map markers
examples.prompt: Create a family of island map markers using the flat-vector art style: harbor, campsite, cave and lookout tower. Share one corner treatment and a compact, limited palette.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 flat-vector 美术风格制作一组岛屿地图标记：港口、营地、洞穴和瞭望塔。统一转角处理，使用紧凑、精简的配色。

style.prompt: Flat vector-style game artwork built from clean geometric silhouettes, solid color fills and a limited shared palette. Consistent corner treatment, balanced negative spaces and a clear visual hierarchy. Use at most one darker flat shape for depth per material, with no texture or continuous gradients. Keep forms readable as compact icons and repeat geometry consistently.
style.negativePrompt: photographic detail, brush texture, raster noise, gradients, soft drop shadows, glass effects, bevels, complex outlines, tiny ornament, text, watermark

constraints.outline: Outline-free filled shapes; separate overlaps through solid value contrast.
